scope: six frozen confirmation families spanning Persona generation, Scene generation and production-shaped Tavern commit/read-back, followed by a research-only conditional Tavern repair

exact_guard.limitation: The exact guard detected prefix and two pre-registered topology constraints but missed most independently reviewed relationship, closed-world Scene and epistemic inventions.

failures.auditor-false-clearance-platform: HTTP 200 plus finish_reason=length at 2048 completion tokens
failures.three-cell-seed-vault: HTTP 200 plus finish_reason=stop followed by strict repair decode failure

conditional_tavern_repair.mutation_boundary: proposal-only research output; no committed Tavern Message, production trace or domain record was rewritten

blinded_paired_review.protocol: Two isolated reviewers saw only authoritative source and randomized candidate A/B replies. They did not see the key, reports, automated scores, implementation or each other. Failed strict repairs were not_evaluable.
shared_findings: The repair reliably improved exact-prefix task adherence where a strict candidate was returned.
The repair did not remove unsupported physical or documentary claims such as invented station details or a parcel pickup form.
The two decode failures remain not_evaluable and cannot count as passes or improvements.

promotion_decision.criterion: at least three paired major reductions, zero new major regressions, and evaluable strict repaired candidates
promotion_decision.reason: The two archived reviewers shared only one pair-axis major reduction, two of six repairs were not evaluable, and the surviving semantic invention majors were outside the exact guard's recall.
